answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the walnut index resolves every citation against the knoll checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the terrace audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1116 identities would post 2418 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
